anchor: 在“互联网+医疗健康”和大数据技术快速发展的背景下，社区卫生服务中心在慢性病管理与随访方面面临信息分散、数据利用率低、协同效率不足等问题。传统依赖纸质或简单表格的管理方式，难以支撑医生管理、患者管理、药品管理、诊疗记录及随访任务等环节的规范化处理，也难以对慢性病患者的随访执行情况、风险等级变化和医生工作量进行持续统计分析。因此，建设面向社区卫生服务中心的慢性病随访信息管理系统，具有一定的现实意义。
replacement: 在社区卫生服务中心日常工作中，慢性病患者数量多、随访周期长，传统纸质登记和分散表格容易造成信息更新不及时、任务交接不清和统计口径不统一。围绕这一问题，本文设计并实现了社区卫生服务中心慢性病随访系统，系统采用B/S结构，以信息管理系统方式整合医生管理、患者管理、诊疗记录、随访任务、随访记录和数据统计分析等业务，使慢性病随访从建档、分配、执行到统计形成连续流程。

anchor: 本文围绕社区卫生服务中心慢性病随访工作的实际需求，设计并实现了一个基于B/S结构的慢性病随访管理系统。系统面向管理员，实现医生管理、患者管理、药品管理、诊疗记录录入、随访任务分配及数据统计等功能；面向社区医生，实现被分配患者的查看与管理、随访任务处理、随访记录填写与查询、报告生成等功能。系统后端采用SpringBoot框架完成业务接口和数据处理，前端采用Vue框架构建浏览器端交互界面，数据库采用MySQL进行数据存储。测试结果表明，系统能够完成社区慢性病随访管理的主要业务流程，具有一定的实用价值。
replacement: 系统后端基于Spring Boot和MyBatis实现接口服务与数据持久化，前端基于Vue和Element Plus实现管理页面，数据库采用MySQL存储用户、医生、患者、诊疗记录、随访任务、随访记录和风险评估等数据。通过功能测试和典型业务流程验证，系统能够完成慢性病患者信息维护、随访任务分配、随访记录填写、风险等级管理和统计分析等功能，为社区卫生服务中心开展慢性病随访提供了较为规范的信息化支撑。

anchor: Under the background of "Internet plus+health care" and rapid development of big data technology, community health service centers face problems such as scattered information, low data utilization rate, and insufficient collaborative efficiency in chronic disease management and follow-up. Traditional management methods that rely on paper records or simple spreadsheets are difficult to support standardized processing of doctor management, patient management, medicine management, medical records, and follow-up tasks. They are also unable to continuously analyze follow-up implementation, risk-level changes, and doctors' workload. Therefore, it is necessary to build a chronic disease follow-up information system for community health service centers.
replacement: Community health service centers need to manage many chronic disease patients over long follow-up cycles. Paper records and scattered spreadsheets often lead to delayed updates, unclear task handover, and inconsistent statistics. To address these problems, this thesis designs and implements a chronic disease follow-up system for community health service centers. The system adopts a B/S structure and works as an information management system that integrates doctor management, patient management, medical records, follow-up tasks, follow-up records, risk assessment, and data statistical analysis into a continuous business process.

anchor: This article focuses on the practical needs of chronic disease follow-up work in community health service centers, and designs and implements a chronic disease follow-up management system based on B/S structure. For administrators, the system realizes doctor management, patient management, medicine management, medical record entry, follow-up task assignment, and data statistics. For community doctors, the system realizes assigned patient viewing, follow-up task processing, follow-up record filling and query, and report generation. The back end uses Spring Boot to provide business interfaces and data processing, the front end uses Vue to build browser-side interaction pages, and MySQL is used for data storage. Test results show that the system can complete the main business process of community chronic disease follow-up management and has practical application value.
replacement: The back end is developed with Spring Boot and MyBatis, the front end is developed with Vue and Element Plus, and MySQL stores users, doctors, patients, medical records, follow-up tasks, follow-up records, and risk assessments. Functional tests and typical process tests show that the system can support patient information maintenance, follow-up task assignment, follow-up record filling, risk-level management, and statistical analysis, providing practical information support for chronic disease follow-up in community health service centers.
